questions.stem: Which of the following is a feature of Hemichordata?
choices: They have a closed circulatory system
They have a water vascular system
questions.solution: Hemichordates have a proboscis gland, which is an excretory organ. They do not have a notochord, which is a feature of chordates. They possess an open circulatory system, not a closed one, and they lack a water vascular system, which is found in echinoderms.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a feature of Cnidaria?

questions.solution: Cnidarians have a central gastro-vascular cavity, which is used for digestion and circulation. They are diploblastic, not pseudocoelomate, and have an open circulatory system. questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of radial symmetry?
questions.solution: Radial symmetry means an organism can be divided into equal parts around a central axis. Starfish, being echinoderms, have this type of symmetry. Earthworms, humans, and frogs have bilateral symmetry, meaning they can only be divided into mirror-image halves along one plane.

questions.stem: What is the function of the water vascular system in echinoderms?
questions.solution: The water vascular system in echinoderms is responsible for movement, as it operates the tube feet that allow the organism to move. questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of an amphibian?
questions.solution: Rana is an example of an amphibian because it is a frog, which is a member of the class Amphibia. Fish, on the other hand, live exclusively in water and have gills for respiration.

questions.stem: Which phylum includes organisms that have a chitinous exoskeleton and jointed appendages?
questions.solution: Annelida includes segmented worms like Nereis, which have a soft body and no exoskeleton. Arthropoda includes insects, spiders, and crustaceans, which have a chitinous exoskeleton and jointed appendages.
